name: Streaming Measuring Systemic Risk Contribution Of International Mutual Funds Cfba972Ef4
text: Measuring Systemic Risk Contribution of International Mutual Funds states that the 2007–09 global financial crisis increased policy and academic attention to interconnected bank and nonbank systemic risk. This independently corresponds to Kaal's account of the crisis triggering a renewed wave of private-fund systemic-risk analysis. The proposition does not isolate private funds or establish their causal contribution to the crisis.
